charges.label: Weight component (₹6.00 per kg of billed weight)
charges.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

charges.label: Distance component (₹2.00 per km of booked lane distance)
charges.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

charges.label: Cold chain premium (20% of freight charge = weight + distance components)
charges.quote: carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components)

accessorials_policy.clause: sagar-roadlines.md §1, §3 (no clause declares unlisted charges non-payable)

document_rules.rule: Invoice lines whose c-note number cannot be matched to a Customer booking are not payable until reconciled.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; each references the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects.
A credit note must cover the full corrected amount.
Payment is due 21 days from invoice date; invoices are pooled, typically fortnightly.

notes: Freight = 6.00*billed_weight_kg + 2.00*distance_km; cold_chain adds 20% of that freight sum. Only standard service offered (§2); express shipments fall outside services_offered. Fragile/residential carry no charge under this contract. No minimums, tiers, distance limits, or invoice-level discounts. No dispute window stated.
